metadata.title: Revisiting candidate high-velocity stars associated with the Sagittarius dwarf spheroidal galaxy

notes: No star qualifies. The 95 objects are selected as high-velocity stars with galactocentric velocities above 400 km s−1 and close Sgr encounters (T:p3-b8, T:p3-b15), not as Galactic-unbound stars in the paper’s final assessment. The authors state that the sole object above 600 km s−1 at about 2.25 kpc lies below the local escape velocity and conclude that no HVS originating from Sgr was identified (T:p3-b15); the abstract and conclusions likewise state that no unbound Sgr HVSs are detected (T:p1-b5, T:p11-b7). J1443+1453 is named only as a prior Sgr-linked candidate at 599 km s−1 (T:p2-b2), without an explicit present-day Galactic-unbound determination; this is also below the paper’s >600 km s−1 HVS threshold. Earlier HVS samples (Li22, Li23, and the unbound candidates cited from Sun et al. 2025) are discussed only in aggregate, and their individual unbound candidates lack supplied identifiers, so no individual follow-up star is identifiable; aggregate high-velocity or proposed-origin statements do not establish every member as Galactic unbound.
